title: Evaluating a radiotherapy deep learning synthetic CT algorithm for PET-MR attenuation correction in the pelvis.
summary: A deep-learning synthetic CT algorithm improved pelvic PET attenuation correction against CT reference images, with near-zero whole-image SUV difference; it did not improve thresholded tumor delineation. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
